title: Doctor host-probe report (zic-rs-doctor-v2)
description: Read-only host probe: reference zic/zdump ToolStatus (typed version_status + hash_status), optional tzdata, compiler identity. Always exit 0 (diagnosis, not gate). Published contract scope: this pins the schema **identity** (the `schema` const) and the top-level object shape. Field-level tightening and full instance-validation against a JSON-Schema validator are a tracked audit-suite item (the core crate carries no validator dependency); see docs/schema-compatibility-policy.md for the versioning rules and tests/schemas.rs for the registry/drift guard.

schema.description: the immutable schema identity; bumped only on a meaning change
